· RSI trajectory (45.9→46.5) + attempting to exit oversold territory, maintaining neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0020→-0.0006) + improvement confirmed, no bearish reversal signal.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.06) + above Pivot S1 ($1.03), based on 5-day low ($1.05).
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + significance if 5-day high ($1.09) is breached.
· 5-day high ($1.09)/low ($1.05), 20-day high ($1.16)/low ($1.05) — range-bound pattern continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.06x) + normal confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + entry conditions upon directional confirmation.
